name: Samara Washington
source:
"She is bright, energetic and really great with people. She's got a good relationship with her boyfriend but doesn't see him as her future husband.
Samara loves a good time, but she can be very serious when required. Her life wasn't easy, but after finding work as Albert's Cafe she finally feels at home.
She has a secret crush on someone, but won't ever hurt her current boyfriend by pursuing it. Maybe one day she will be free to find her real love."

[In-game description]
